subject: [hw] V40 start: /dev/vcu model + APPEND-ONLY note
body: V40 (/dev/vcu device model, vcu/n2vcu.c) starting. Read PLAN/TASK/FACTS/D01 vcu_usage.md/mtk_vcu.c. Will implement the mtk_vcu ioctl+mmap ABI over n2vc_hw with the 32-bit AAPCS layouts (verified with clang --target=armv7a-linux-gnueabi against the kernel UAPI header: mem_obj 0x20, share_obj 0x58, gce_cmdq_obj 0x20, gce_obj 0x10, map_obj 0x10, gce_cmds 0xe808; SET_OBJECT 0x40587600, PA_ALLOC 0xc0207606, PA_FREE 0xc0207607, GCE_FLUSH 0x40207608, GCE_WAIT 0x40107609, GET_OBJECT 0xc058760a). Interface post to hw-v41 follows in a few minutes. No phone, host tests only.
